Title: Create employee with valid data
Description: Verify creating an employee with valid id, name, and role returns created status and employee data
Pre-Conditions: Employee id does not exist in the system
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with valid employee JSON body containing id, name, and role
Expected Result: Response status is 201 Created with Location header and response body contains created employee data

Title: Create employee with missing id
Description: Verify creating an employee without id returns bad request with error message
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with employee JSON body missing id field
Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Create employee with missing name
Description: Verify creating an employee without name returns bad request with error message
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with employee JSON body missing name field
Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Create employee with empty name
Description: Verify creating an employee with empty name returns bad request with error message
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with employee JSON body where name is empty string
Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Create employee with missing role
Description: Verify creating an employee without role returns bad request with error message
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with employee JSON body missing role field
Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Create employee with empty role
Description: Verify creating an employee with empty role returns bad request with error message
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with employee JSON body where role is empty string
Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Create employee with null body
Description: Verify creating an employee with null request body returns bad request with error message
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with null body
Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Get all employees successfully
Description: Verify that GET /api/employee returns a list of all employees
Pre-Conditions: At least one employee exists in the repository
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employee
Receive response
Expected Result: Response contains list of employees

Title: Get all employees when no employees exist
Description: Verify that GET /api/employee returns an empty list when no employees exist
Pre-Conditions: No employees exist in the repository
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employee
Receive response
Expected Result: Response contains empty list

Title: Get employee by valid id
Description: Verify that GET /api/employee/{id} returns employee details when a valid id is provided
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the database
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employee/{id} with valid employee id
Expected Result: Response contains employee details with status 200

Title: Get employee by non-existing id
Description: Verify that GET /api/employee/{id} returns 404 when employee id does not exist
Pre-Conditions: No employee exists with the given id
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employee/{id} with non-existing employee id
Expected Result: Response contains message 'employee not found' with status 404

Title: Get employee with null id
Description: Verify that GET /api/employee/{id} returns 400 when id is null
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employee/{id} with null id
Expected Result: Response contains message 'id is required' with status 400

Title: Update employee with valid id and valid body
Description: Verify updating an existing employee with valid id and valid request body updates the employee and returns status 200
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the repository
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id and valid employee data in request body
Expected Result: Response status is 200 OK and response body contains updated employee data

Title: Update employee with null id
Description: Verify updating employee with null id returns bad request with message 'id is required'
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with id as null and valid employee data in request body
Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request and response body contains message 'id is required'

Title: Update employee with null request body
Description: Verify updating employee with null request body returns bad request with message 'request body is required'
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the repository
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id and null request body
Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request and response body contains message 'request body is required'

Title: Update employee with non-existing id
Description: Verify updating employee with id that does not exist returns 404 with message 'employee not found'
Pre-Conditions: No employee exists with given id
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with non-existing id and valid employee data in request body
Expected Result: Response status is 404 Not Found and response body contains message 'employee not found'

Title: Update employee with partial fields in request body
Description: Verify updating employee with partial fields updates only those fields and returns status 200
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the repository
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id and partial employee data in request body
Expected Result: Response status is 200 OK and response body contains employee data with updated role and other fields unchanged

Title: Delete employee with valid id
Description: Verify deleting an existing employee by valid id returns 204 status
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the database
Test Steps: Send DELETE request to /api/employee/{id} with valid existing employee id
Expected Result: Response status is 204 No Content and employee is deleted

Title: Delete employee with non-existing id
Description: Verify deleting an employee with non-existing id returns 404 status with message
Pre-Conditions: No employee exists with the given id
Test Steps: Send DELETE request to /api/employee/{id} with non-existing employee id
Expected Result: Response status is 404 Not Found with message 'employee not found'

Title: Delete employee with null id
Description: Verify deleting an employee with null id returns 400 status with message
Test Steps: Send DELETE request to /api/employee/{id} with null or missing id
Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with message 'id is required'

Title: Mark batch attendance with valid payload
Description: Send a valid list of attendance records to mark batch attendance
Test Steps: Prepare a list of attendance DTOs with valid employeeId, absent, and optional date
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as body
Verify response status and content
Expected Result: Response contains savedCount equal to number of valid entries, savedRecords list with attendance records, presentCount, absentCount, and empty invalidEntries list

Title: Mark batch attendance with empty payload
Description: Send an empty list to mark batch attendance endpoint
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with empty list as body
Verify response status and error message
Expected Result: Response contains message 'payload is empty'

Title: Mark batch attendance with null payload
Description: Send null as payload to mark batch attendance endpoint
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with null body
Verify response status and error message
Expected Result: Response contains message 'payload is empty'

Title: Mark batch attendance with some invalid entries
Description: Send a list with some attendance DTOs missing required fields
Test Steps: Prepare a list of attendance DTOs where some have null employeeId or absent
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as body
Verify response status and content including invalidEntries list
Expected Result: Response contains savedCount for valid entries, savedRecords list, presentCount, absentCount, and invalidEntries list with employeeIds of invalid entries

Title: Mark attendance with valid employeeId and absent
Description: Verify marking attendance with valid employeeId and absent status returns 200 and attendance record
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing valid employeeId and absent
Verify response status is 200
Verify response body contains attendance record with given employeeId and absent status
Expected Result: Response status 200 with attendance record containing employeeId 1 and absent true

Title: Mark attendance with valid employeeId and absent false
Description: Verify marking attendance with valid employeeId and absent false returns 200 and attendance record
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing valid employeeId and absent false
Verify response status is 200
Verify response body contains attendance record with given employeeId and absent false
Expected Result: Response status 200 with attendance record containing employeeId 1 and absent false

Title: Mark attendance with null request body
Description: Verify marking attendance with null request body returns 400 with error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with null body
Verify response status is 400
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with message 'employeeId and absent required'

Title: Mark attendance with missing employeeId
Description: Verify marking attendance with missing employeeId returns 400 with error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body missing employeeId
Verify response status is 400
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with message 'employeeId and absent required'

Title: Mark attendance with missing absent field
Description: Verify marking attendance with missing absent field returns 400 with error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body missing absent field
Verify response status is 400
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with message 'employeeId and absent required'

Title: Mark attendance with null date uses current date
Description: Verify marking attendance with null date uses current date and returns 200
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing employeeId, absent and null date
Verify response status is 200
Verify response body contains attendance record with current date
Expected Result: Response status 200 with attendance record containing current date
